subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: Should maintainers keep this umbrella as the coordination item while splitting the remaining work into security/auth, installer/runtime, and session-state tracks, or choose one narrower canonical issue to replace it?
rationale: The remaining work is real but spans security-sensitive auth persistence, provider migration, package/update compatibility, and session-state semantics, so automation cannot safely choose one product boundary or persistence policy.

options.title: Split Under This Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the coordination parent and route focused fixes through the existing narrower issues and PRs.

options.title: Promote A Narrow Canonical
options.body: Pick one open related issue as canonical and close this only after every remaining acceptance criterion is explicitly covered there.

options.title: Close As Product Direction Rejected
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide browser-restart token persistence and automatic OAuth propagation should not be OpenClaw behavior.

recommendation.title: Split Under This Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the coordination parent and route focused fixes through the existing narrower issues and PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main provenance and merged PR metadata make steipete the strongest available router across the implicated agent, auth, package, and dashboard surfaces.
